metadata.displayName: Serve a model behind an API endpoint
metadata.description: Pick a model, choose whether it stays warm or sleeps when idle, and get a private cluster with a working HTTP endpoint. You get your own kubeconfig, so you can inspect and change everything inside your project yourself.

parameters.name: projectName
parameters.label: Project name
parameters.help: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. This becomes the name of your cluster and your endpoint, and it cannot be changed afterwards.

parameters.name: model
parameters.label: Model
parameters.help: Choose from the models the platform team has reviewed and mirrored.

parameters.name: availability
parameters.label: Availability
parameters.help: Always on answers immediately but holds a GPU the whole time. On demand sleeps when idle and frees the GPU, but the first request after a nap takes about 15 seconds to wake it.

values.label: Always on
values.description: Answers immediately, day or night. Holds a GPU the whole time, whether or not anyone is using it.

values.label: On demand
values.description: Sleeps when nobody is using it and frees the GPU for someone else. The first request after a nap takes about 15 seconds to wake it.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.label: Size
parameters.help: How much of the shared hardware your project may use at once. Both sizes are one GPU on this local rehearsal cluster.

parameters.name: durationDays
parameters.label: How long do you need it?
parameters.help: Your project is removed automatically when this runs out, so nothing is left holding hardware after you have finished with it. Ask for an extension if you need longer.
